item.title: Aggregate reports by account and currency
item.brief: Implement reports side of shared contract: read currency column when present and validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; absent legacy currency means USD. Aggregate by account and currency; output header account,currency,total_cents, sorted by account then currency. Malformed currency prints stderr error and exits 2. Update README, keep/add tests as requested, commit changes.

item.title: Emit and validate transaction currencies in ledger
item.brief: Implement the ledger side of the shared contract: accept optional fourth TSV currency field, default USD, validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, report malformed currency with input line number and exit status 2; emit the new CSV header and currency on every row. Preserve other input errors at exit 1. Update README, keep/add tests as requested, commit changes.

reasons: sizer: ordinary -> medium; unchanged: the learned route's effort

state.summary:
Added optional validated transaction currency to ledger TSV parsing and CSV output. Default currency is USD; malformed currency reports its input line and exits 2, while other parse errors still exit 1. Updated README and regression coverage. Formatting, Clippy, tests, and diff checks pass on tree 55419112d2a91cddcb03e1c67f4f1644bbcfd18d. Review found and fixed acceptance of whitespace-padded codes; the delta review passed.

pr.body: Updated src/lib.rs to parse an optional fourth TSV field, validate raw currency codes, and render the four-column CSV contract; src/main.rs reports currency validation failures with line numbers and status 2 while retaining status 1 for other input errors. README.md documents the input/output and exit codes. tests/ledger.rs covers default and explicit currencies, malformed codes (including padded values), line-numbered CLI errors, and unchanged status for other input errors. Verified with cargo fmt -- --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test, and git diff --check; all passed. Whole-change review read base 3c47e1263ce14ca35fc67e3fd0483b20d8d84d99 through 46dc2c542a10a820206dae0e6d198b1faf8edd73 and identified whitespace trimming as a blocker. Fixed in 7dd0543d6d24ac8119b65d69eec947fd22218f62; delta review from 46dc2c542a10a820206dae0e6d198b1faf8edd73 passed. No follow-ups remain. Assumption: surrounding whitespace is invalid because currency must be exactly three uppercase ASCII letters.
pr.summary: Added currency to each ledger CSV record. Before: output had date, account, and amount; now every row emits currency, defaulting to USD when omitted. Supplied values must be exactly three uppercase ASCII letters.
pr.title: add transaction currency to ledger output
